summary: Lakeshore Acquisition III Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that CPRO Electronics Co. Ltd. (CPRO Korea) wired a third extension payment of $67,500 into the trust account under the May 22, 2026 merger agreement, extending the deadline to complete its initial business combination one month from October 1 to November 1, 2026. No price per share, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. The payment structure shifts extension economics to the counterparty; the de-SPAC remains unfinanced and unsigned at a definitive proxy level, so watch the November 1 deadline and further monthly extension payments.
